segments.he: אֶחָד הַנִּכְנָס לָעֲזָרָה וְאֶחָד הַנִּכְנָס לְתוֹסֶפֶת הָעֲזָרָה, שֶׁאֵין מוֹסִיפִין עַל הָעִיר וְעַל הָעֲזָרוֹת אֶלָּא בְּמֶלֶךְ וְנָבִיא וְאוּרִים וְתוּמִּים וְסַנְהֶדְרִין שֶׁל שִׁבְעִים וְאֶחָד, וּבִשְׁתֵּי תּוֹדוֹת וּבְשִׁיר.
segments.en: As for the boundaries of the Temple with regard to the halakhot of impurity, «the same» halakha applies to «one who enters the» area that was part of the original Temple «courtyard and» to «one who enters the» later «addition to the» Temple «courtyard,» because the additional section is sanctified with the full sanctity of the Temple courtyard. The mishna notes: «As, additions can be made to the city» of Jerusalem «or to the» Temple «courtyards only by» a special body comprising the «king, a prophet, the Urim VeTummim, and the Sanhedrin of seventy-one» judges, «and with two thanks-offerings and with» a special «song.» Once the addition to the courtyard is made by this body and this process, it is given the full sanctity of the original courtyard area.

segments.he: וּבֵית דִּין מְהַלְּכִין, וּשְׁתֵּי תּוֹדוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן, וְכׇל יִשְׂרָאֵל אַחֲרֵיהֶם.
segments.en: The mishna provides certain details of the consecration ceremony. «And the court» would «move» forward, «and two thanks-offerings» would be brought «after them, and all of the Jewish people» would follow «behind them.»

moves.cueHe: אחד הנכנס לעזרה ואחד הנכנס לתוספת העזרה
moves.summary: the addition to the courtyard has full sanctity; additions require king, prophet, Urim veTummim, Sanhedrin, two thanks-offerings and song
